requiredFindings.title: A non-INIT floor at lastSeq 0 with no carrier matches no row
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The floor decodes as grantGeneration 2, lastSeq 0, tailSha256 null, and the namespace has no carrier and no witness. Row 4 resumes INIT only for grantGeneration 1 at lastSeq 0. Row 5 quarantines uncertainTailLoss only when a witness is present or lastSeq is above 0. No row matches. Required: a present floor with no carrier and no witness is uncertainTailLoss unless it is the INIT floor, grantGeneration 1 and lastSeq 0.

scope: Law X3b r3. r2 RF-1 and RF-2 are closed. A present floor at lastSeq 0 with grantGeneration other than 1, no carrier, and no witness matches no row. No product cargo.
